items.text: One day after DNP, Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as full participant in Thursday practice (ankle/rest).
items.why: Maintenance/rest day Wednesday; returned full Thursday.
items.implication: Expected to play Week 8 vs Titans; minimal concern.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets as WR1 when active.

items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as full participant for second straight day (ankle).
items.why: First full practices since Week 4 ankle injury; Rapoport says poised to return.
items.implication: Strongly expected to start vs Bills; unlocks offense.
items.opportunity: Full snaps unlocks higher YPRR/usage for skill players.

items.text: After limited Wednesday, Patriots listed WR AJ Brown as non-participant Thursday due to ankle and knee injuries.
items.why: Knee issue flared (added to ankle); not spotted at practice; status up in air for Sunday.
items.implication: Game-time decision or possible OUT vs Dolphins; monitor Friday.

items.text: Zay Flowers is my WR5 this week. Lamar Jackson expected back and I LOVE what that means for Flowers.
items.why: Lamar return unlocks; prior efficiency elite even with Huntley.
items.implication: Strong start recommendation; WR1/2 upside this week.
items.opportunity: Elevated target quality and volume with dual-threat QB.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice from IR (chest).
items.why: Missed 4 games; window open, realistic to play MNF vs Bears per coach.
items.implication: Crowds already busy backfield (Wilson/Charbonnet/Holani); monitor activation and snaps.
items.opportunity: Potential shared carries/routes if activated; prior lead role pre-injury.
items.conflict: Berry questions immediate lineup viability in crowded room.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle DNP Wednesday after aggravating chest injury; availability uncertain for Week 8 vs Chiefs.
items.why: Chest aggravation in Week 7; status TBD on further practice.
items.implication: Possible limited or OUT; production already soft.
items.opportunity: If out, more targets to Courtland Sutton/Pat Bryant/Marvin Mims.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) listed non-participants Wednesday practice.
items.why: Gibbs shoulder, St. Brown ankle from prior game; Campbell indicated expected rest for St. Brown; no indication miss Sunday.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri; both likely play vs Vikings but rest day signals management.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, boosts Jameson Williams/LaPorta/Montgomery shares.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup? (crowded backfield question).
items.why: Return from IR into crowded SEA backfield with Wilson/Charbonnet/Holani.
items.implication: Hold/watch snaps; not automatic start even if active Week 8.
items.opportunity: Potential committee; prior 1st-round role could reclaim share.
items.conflict: Designation positive but role unclear vs usage of current backs.

items.text: Adam Levitan/Evan Silva: “I do think it’s time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman” in DEN backfield discussion post-return (led snaps/carries).
items.why: Coleman led snaps/rush/routes in return; Payton wants more touches; time to prioritize over others.
items.implication: Coleman rising in committee; Dobbins/Harvey shares at risk of further dilution.
items.opportunity: Coleman expanding early-down + pass-game role; goal-line potential.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Extremely excited for Declan Doyle cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR efficiency even without Lamar; offense already efficient; Lamar unlocks ceiling.
items.implication: Major WR upside boost with Lamar return; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Higher quality targets, deeper shots, red-zone with dual-threat QB.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on HATE list this week. Production hasn’t been there; Chiefs allowed just one TD to opposing WR all season (to JSN).
items.why: Soft production + tough matchup (Chiefs elite vs WR TDs) + chest injury uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Limited if active; targets suppressed by defense/injury.

items.text: Keeping it OPEN on Sam LaPorta. Could be in for a big day against Vikings defense sure to put pressure on Jared Goff.
items.why: Lions allow most FP/g to TEs? Wait, matchup: Vikes pressure forces checkdowns; LaPorta TE6 PPG.
items.implication: Viable start/stream; upside in pass-heavy script.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes if Gibbs/St. Brown managed or pressure high.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, limited supporting cast, and shaded coverage; stadium knows ball is going to him.
items.why: Elite efficiency/talent overcoming scheme/coverage hits and low supporting cast.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 upside; trust over raw opportunity metrics.
items.opportunity: High target share + YAC/YPRR elite; continue force-feeding.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given talent/schedule/concentration.
items.why: Defensive woes force high volume; elite talent concentration and schedule.
items.implication: Lock in top-tier starts ROS; Gibbs clear RB1, St. Brown elite WR.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target shares across board; red-zone heavy.
